name: tests-50pct-containerlab-topology-wide-interface-claim-e246
instr:
Add topology interface claims keyed by namespace and effective interface. Preserve existing behaviour.

Transactions retain input order and allow shared references. Incompatible exclusive claims return *ClaimConflict with the key and ordered Existing/Incoming origins; reversing input reverses these origins. Rollback permits fresh retries. Error() is stable and includes namespace, interface, and both link and endpoint indices for each claim mode.

ResolveLinks publishes claims matching retained endpoints in order. Repeated resolution replaces claims. A later missing-node failure leaves no claims or endpoints. Duplicate interfaces report every conflict in topology order, retaining declared interface identities and the effective key. Host interfaces use namespace "host"; management attachments use "mgmt-net". Raw host, macvlan and management links yield a container-owned claim followed respectively by a consumed host, referenced host or referenced management claim; node-filtered host links yield none. Macvlan references conflict with host consumption of the same interface.

DeployLinks rejects links outside the current committed set. Cancelled deployment releases untransferred claims and permits resolution again. Dry-run Deploy succeeds with Apply.DryRun=true and publishes macvlan, management and host keys. PrintClaimReport accepts "table" and "json", including namespace and interface in output.

AddEndpointWithClaim retains the endpoint and commits its effective node/interface
